name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_long: A programmer based in India. I write here irregularly but with intention.
quote: An idiot admires complexity, a genius admires simplicity
quoteAuthor: Terry Davis, creator of Temple OS

highlights: Developed a backend polling service in Go to monitor Hetzner Cloud infrastructure and detect server lifecycle events through REST API polling and state reconciliation workflows.
Implemented transactional audit logging and an Outbox-based webhook delivery system with retries, ensuring idempotent event processing and reliable, duplicate-free alerts.
Deployed a centralized Kubernetes observability stack using Grafana Alloy, Loki, Grafana, and ArgoCD, enabling cluster-wide log aggregation across services.
Implemented Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) for Kubernetes workloads to improve capacity planning through automated resource recommendations.
